reported_snapshot.total_debt_note: Up from $3.23B in Q2 after the $4.75B August 2026 senior notes offering
reported_snapshot.free_cash_flow_note: FCF fell from $1.53B a year earlier (4% margin) as inventory rose ~$3B q/q to $11.46B and receivables rose 26% to $9.21B; 9-month FCF $4.68B; trailing-12-month FCF ~ $7.06B (Trefis)
reported_snapshot.rpo_backlog: Not disclosed as a headline figure; multi-GW customer agreements (OpenAI 6 GW, Meta 6 GW, Anthropic up to 2 GW) are framework/purchase agreements, not reported backlog

off_balance_items.description: Unconditional, non-cancellable (or penalty-bearing) purchase commitments for wafers (TSMC is sole source for all <=7nm CPUs/GPUs), substrates, HBM memory, other components and ATMP services. $11.2B due rest of 2026, $22.2B in 2027, $15.4B 2028+. $33.4B is due by end of FY2027. Sized for the MI450/Helios ramp; if AI orders slip, AMD still owes these.
off_balance_items.counterparty: TSMC, memory suppliers, ATMP JVs and other suppliers
off_balance_items.source_title: AMD Form 10-Q for quarter ended Sept 26, 2026 (commitments note)

off_balance_items.description: Cloud compute capacity commitments: AMD has committed to buy GPU compute capacity from cloud service providers to the extent the capacity is not placed with third-party customers (or capacity AMD reserved to resell). Classic demand backstop for neoclouds; amounts fall as third parties pay. $1.4B due 2027, $1.6B 2028, $1.5B 2029.
off_balance_items.counterparty: Unnamed cloud service providers (neoclouds); reported example: Crusoe

off_balance_items.description: Data center lease guarantees: AMD guarantees commercial partners' data-center lease payments, max gross exposure $7.7B with terms up to 15 years; on default AMD may assume the leases. Plus commercial partner debt guarantees (borrowings used to finance data-center infrastructure) of $750M with terms up to 6 months. Total max $8.5B; fair value 'not material', nothing paid to date.

Data center leases signed by AMD but not yet commenced, which AMD expects to assign or sublease to commercial partners: aggregate future payments $13.3B, 10-15 year terms, starting Q2 FY2027. AMD is the head lessee; if partners can't take them, AMD carries the rent. Separately $0.2B of ordinary operating leases not yet commenced.
off_balance_items.counterparty: Data-center landlords; intended sub-lessees are unnamed commercial partners

off_balance_items.description: Reported backstop of a $300M Goldman Sachs loan to Crusoe to buy AMD chips for an Ohio data center (built by Brookfield-backed 5C); AMD agreed to rent the chips back if Crusoe can't find customers, cutting Crusoe's rate to ~6%. Likely already captured inside the 10-Q cloud-capacity or partner-debt guarantee figures, so not added to the total.
off_balance_items.source_title: Reuters: AMD to backstop $300 million Crusoe loan, The Information reports

off_balance_items.description: Anthropic: July 2026 hardware supply agreement for up to 2 GW of Helios/MI450 racks (Anthropic expects >$20B spend if it takes the full initial capacity, from 1H 2027). AMD committed to buy up to $5.0B of Anthropic Class N stock, drawn by Anthropic in increments as GPU delivery milestones are hit. $2.5B (33.8M shares) bought in the IPO concurrent private placement at $83 (closed after Nov 19 IPO); up to $2.5B more tied to future deliveries. AMD is funding a customer that buys its chips.
off_balance_items.source_title: AMD/Anthropic partnership release; Anthropic S-1/A via TIKR & Observer

off_balance_items.description: Broader equity investment commitments of up to $5.1B (primarily private AI companies, through FY2028) per 10-Q; likely includes the Anthropic $5B commitment (so not double counted). In addition AMD invested $1.0B in an unnamed public company's equity offering in October 2026.
off_balance_items.counterparty: Privately held AI/tech companies (incl. likely Anthropic); one unnamed public company

off_balance_items.description: OpenAI: 6 GW multi-generation Instinct GPU agreement (first 1 GW MI450 from 2H 2026; est. >$100B revenue over ~4 years). AMD issued OpenAI a warrant for up to 160M AMD shares at $0.01, vesting per GW purchased and AMD price targets up to $600. Effectively paying the customer in AMD equity to buy AMD chips (vendor financing via equity). TensorWave separately signed a 6-yr, 457 MW AMD-based capacity deal serving OpenAI (Nov 2026).

Meta: 6 GW agreement (custom MI450-based GPU, first GW shipping 2H 2026; Reuters: up to $60B over 5 years) with an identical 160M-share $0.01 warrant. Combined OpenAI+Meta warrants = up to 320M shares (~17% of ~1.63B diluted shares). As of 9/26/26 no tranche vested; warrant liability $1.2B on balance sheet, $4.5B unrecognized grant-date fair value to be booked as contra-revenue as sales occur; Q3 took a $1.2B non-cash remeasurement charge.
off_balance_items.source_title: AMD 8-K (Meta warrant) and AMD 10-Q Q3 2026 (warrant accounting)

off_balance_items.description: Data Center is 64% of revenue (vs 47% a year ago). AMD's 2027 plan (>80% revenue growth guided per reports) leans on three anchor AI customers: OpenAI (6 GW, cash-burning, vendor-financed by AMD/Nvidia/Broadcom), Meta (6 GW) and Anthropic (2 GW, AMD-funded). 10-Q: 'a small number of customers will continue to account for a significant part of our revenue and receivables'. No customer % disclosed.
off_balance_items.counterparty: OpenAI, Meta, Anthropic, Microsoft, Oracle, neoclouds

off_balance_items.description: Export-control exposure: Hunterbrook short report (Nov 19) alleges AMD firmware reached blacklisted Chinese server maker IEIT; new US license rule (Nov 19) for advanced chips to Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Brazil (Singapore was ~12.4% of 2025 revenue by billing). AMD previously took ~$800M MI308 charge (Q2 2025). AMD denies wrongdoing.
off_balance_items.source_title: The Globe and Mail / Reuters: AMD shares dip as report says China ties could invite U.S. scrutiny

total_note: Sum of hard, 10-Q-quantified items as of 2026-09-26: purchase commitments $48.8B + cloud capacity backstops $6.2B + data-center leases not commenced (to be subleased to partners) $13.3B + partner lease/debt guarantees $8.5B + equity investment commitments $5.1B (assumed to include the Anthropic $5B; Anthropic not added separately) = $81.9B. Excluded: Crusoe $0.3B (likely inside the 10-Q figures), the $1.0B Oct public-company investment (already paid), warrant values (stock-settled, contingent), and multi-GW customer deals (revenue, not obligations). Excluding ordinary supply purchase commitments, the customer-support exposures (capacity backstops + leases + guarantees + equity) are ~$33.1B, about 4.7x trailing-12-month FCF of ~$7.1B. These are maximums; none has been paid out yet.

credit_signals.detail: Anticipated ratings A1 (Moody's) / A (S&P) on the August 2026 senior notes; investment grade with wide headroom.

Record $4.75B senior unsecured offering closed Aug 17, 2026: $1.25B 4.60% 2029 (YTM 4.64%, T+43bp), $1.5B 5.00% 2031, $1.0B 5.25% 2033, $1.0B 5.50% 2036 (YTM 5.53%); 'general corporate purposes'. Total debt more than doubled to $7.1B.

Goldman Sachs: AMD 5-yr CDS widened 26.5bp in one week to ~147bp, ~55bp off its low two months earlier; chipmaker CDS basket (AVGO, AMD, NVDA, INTC) now above hyperscalers for first time, attributed to customer financing/guarantees.
Barclays: AMD 5-yr CDS up ~177% in six months from ~40bp area; recommends viewing chip suppliers as 'lenders with concentrated loan books'.
Up to 320M shares owed to OpenAI and Meta under performance warrants; Anthropic placement and acquisitions (World Labs ~$8.2B all-stock; Taalas ~$2.9B cash+stock) use stock.

news_context.headline_summary: AMD-Anthropic deal: up to 2 GW of MI450 Helios racks from 1H 2027; AMD commits up to $5B equity investment in Anthropic.
news_context.why_it_matters: Textbook vendor financing: AMD funds a customer that buys its chips; investment is paid out as deliveries happen.

news_context.headline_summary: AMD closes record $4.75B bond sale at A1/A ratings.
news_context.why_it_matters: AMD shifts from net-cash simplicity toward borrowing to fund inventory, capacity and customer support ahead of the AI ramp.

news_context.headline_summary: Q3: record $13.4B revenue (+45%), Data Center $8.5B (+97%), Q4 guide ~$17B; but FCF only $554M as inventory jumped $3B; $1.2B warrant remeasurement charge.
news_context.why_it_matters: Profits rising but cash is being tied up in inventory/receivables; the 10-Q revealed $8.5B of partner guarantees, $13.3B of leases to sublease and $6.2B of capacity backstops.

news_context.headline_summary: Goldman: chipmaker CDS (incl. AMD ~147bp) rise above hyperscalers for first time.
news_context.why_it_matters: Credit markets are starting to price chip suppliers as lenders to the AI buildout.

news_context.headline_summary: TensorWave signs 6-yr, 457 MW AMD MI455X/Helios compute deal for OpenAI, online 1H 2027-early 2028.
news_context.why_it_matters: OpenAI volume flowing through a neocloud intermediary - the kind of partner AMD's lease guarantees and capacity backstops support.

news_context.headline_summary: Anthropic IPO at $83; AMD buys $2.5B in concurrent private placement; Anthropic fell 8.5% on day two and AMD fell sharply.
news_context.why_it_matters: AMD now holds marked-to-market equity in a customer; customer stock weakness hits AMD twice (investment value and demand confidence).

news_context.headline_summary: Hunterbrook short report on China/IEIT firmware plus new US license rule for 5 Asian/LatAm countries; AMD -8% Nov 19 and ~-13% Nov 20.
news_context.why_it_matters: Regulatory risk to the Asia shipment pipeline that backs the Q4 and 2027 ramp; AMD denies the claims.

hidden_leverage_assessment.rationale: On its own books AMD looks safe: $15.8B cash vs $7.1B debt and A-grade ratings. But the 10-Q shows AMD is now propping up its customers: it guarantees $8.5B of partners' data-center leases and loans, has signed $13.3B of data-center leases it plans to pass to partners, promises to buy $6.2B of cloud capacity nobody else rents, and is investing up to $5B in Anthropic. It also pays OpenAI and Meta in its own stock (up to 320M shares) to buy its GPUs, and owes $48.8B to suppliers, mostly by end-2027. Those customer-support items (~$33B) are about 4-5x AMD's yearly free cash flow, which shrank to $554M last quarter as inventory piled up.
hidden_leverage_assessment.biggest_hidden_risk: If OpenAI, Anthropic or the neoclouds it backs slow their GPU purchases, AMD gets hit at once by unsold inventory against $48.8B of supply commitments plus calls on up to ~$28B of lease guarantees and capacity backstops.
hidden_leverage_assessment.what_would_change_my_mind: Seeing MI450/Helios revenue convert to strong free cash flow in Q4 2026-Q1 2027 (inventory falling) while the guarantee, lease and capacity-backstop totals shrink rather than grow.
